text_block_list.text:
Transcend injured herself during training,
so I brought her to the infirmary, but...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Oww...
Honestly, this injury might be a little bad."
choice_data_list: That was a misjudgment on my part. I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Y'know, I really don't think there's any such thing as failure in this world.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: There is only 'the journey toward success.'

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ...Well! If we quit now, it really will be a "failure."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
choice_data_list: Let's get some rest for our next success.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hmm.
I see, that too is a step forward.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well then, can we at least have a meeting?
To prepare for what's next, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Aha, that's the spirit.
Well then, let's get right down to—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Train-chan. Need an assist.
...Literally can't move.

I rushed over to attend to her
as she was immobilized by the pain...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: My legs aren't my only weapon, you know.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
If I can't run, I'll holed up in the library.
I'll thoroughly research the most effective recovery methods
suited to my symptoms and—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
First, ultra-fast injury recovery! Followed by crazy growth!
...Ta-da~♪

Afterward, applying the knowledge she gained,
she was able to make a smooth comeback!
